claims.quote: The Acre cory, Hoplisoma acrense, long known as Corydoras acrensis, is an armoured catfish that appears to be endemic to the rio Juruá basin in Acre State, Brazil.
Type locality is 'Furo do Lago São Francisco, 7°40'S, 72°39'W, tributary at left bank of Rio Juruá, Acre State, Brazil', and Hoplisoma acrense appears to be endemic to the rio Juruá basin.
